assessment.note: This experiment is intentionally diagnostic. It anchors each regime to the observed Google mobility mean, then preserves a weighted mix of LLM and heuristic within-regime profile deviations. If this sharply reduces error, the main failure in exp007 is the absolute regime-level mobility scale, not the existence of profile differentiation itself.

diagnosis.main_read: If the anchored diagnostic sharply reduces mobility error, exp007 mainly failed on the absolute regime-level mobility scale rather than on the existence of profile-level differentiation.
